newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JOHANNESBURG TO HOST ALL-AFRICA GAMES IN 1999.
newsitem.headline: JOHANNESBURG TO HOST ALL-AFRICA GAMES IN 1999.

text.p: Johannesburg has been chosen as the host city for the 1999 All Africa Games, a city sports official said on Tuesday.
"Johannesburg will be hosting the event and it has more than enough venues and accommodation to make it a very successful occasion," Junior Ramovha of the Johannesburg sports office said.
He said the city was chosen ahead of Cape Town which is bidding to host the 2004 Summer Olympics.

The use of taxpayers' money would be kept to a minimum by encouraging the private sector to invest in the Games. Funds spent by the city would be used to build facilities that communities could use in the future, he said.
"We don't have any major sponsors yet but over the next month we will put a package together to put to large companies."
He said there had been criticism that the 1995 Games in Zimbabwe were too ambitious and South African officials had taken note of the complaints to try to avoid similar mistakes.
South African sports minister Steve Tshwete is currently in Algiers with other African sports ministers at the annual meeting of their Supreme Council of Sports to discuss the Games.
